description:
Use the Anthropic and OpenAI expansion work to pressure-test the package thesis and tighten the architecture.

Scope:
- compare the provider differences discovered during implementation and verification
- collapse shared behavior back into common execution-plan logic where possible
- identify the irreducible provider/model edge cases that deserve policy rules, surfaces, or adapters
- document where the architecture held up well and where it needed additional structure
- leave behind a cleaner map for scaling to hundreds or thousands of models

Outcome:
- a sharper distinction between metadata-driven support and code-driven exceptions
- a clearer next wave of implementation priorities
title: Pressure-test cross-provider alignment and fold findings into the architecture
